description_en: Queries certificate information for a specified accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainCertificateInfo查询指定加速域名证书信息
name: DescribeDomainCertificateInfo

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持单个查询
parameters.name: domain_name

CertDomainName.description_en: The domain name that matches the certificate

CertExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate

CertLife.description_en:
The unit of the certificate validity period.

months

years
CertLife.description_zh:
证书时长单位。

months：月。
years：年

CertOrg.description_en: The name of the certificate authority (CA) that issued the certificate

CertRegion.description_en: The region where the certificate is located

CertStartTime.description_en: The start time of the certificate validity period

CertType.description_en:
The type of the certificate.

free: A free certificate.

cas: An Alibaba Cloud Security certificate.

upload: A custom certificate that you uploaded
CertType.description_zh:
证书类型。

free：免费证书。

cas：云盾证书。

upload：自定义上传

CertUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the certificate was updated

DomainCnameStatus.description_en:
The CNAME status of the domain name.

ok: The CNAME record of the domain name points to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

cname_error: The CNAME record of the domain name does not point to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

top_domain_cname_error: The CNAME record of the top-level domain name does not point to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported
DomainCnameStatus.description_zh:
域名CNAME状态。

ok：域名CNAME已切到阿里云CDN。

cname_error：域名CNAME错误，没有切到阿里云CDN。

top_domain_cname_error：顶级域名CNAME错误，没有切到阿里云CDN。

unsupport_wildcard：不支持泛域名

ServerCertificate.description_en: The public key of the certificate

ServerCertificateStatus.description_en:
The status of HTTPS.

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
ServerCertificateStatus.description_zh:
https开启状态。

on：已开启。

off：未开启

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate.

success: The certificate has taken effect.

checking: The system is checking whether the domain name is added to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

cname_error: The CNAME record of the domain name does not point to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

top_domain_cname_error: The CNAME record of the top-level domain name does not point to Alibaba Cloud CDN.

domain_invalid: The domain name contains invalid characters.

unsupport_wildcard: Wildcard domain names are not supported.

applying: The certificate application is in progress.

get_token_timeout: The certificate application timed out.

check_token_timeout: The verification timed out.

get_cert_timeout: The request to obtain the certificate timed out.

failed: The certificate application failed
Status.description_zh:
证书状态。

success：已生效。
checking：检测域名是否在阿里云CDN。
cname_error：域名没有切到阿里云CDN。
top_domain_cname_error：顶级域名没有切到阿里云CDN。
domain_invalid：域名包含非法字符。
unsupport_wildcard：不支持泛域名。
applying：证书申请中。
get_token_timeout：证书申请超时。
check_token_timeout：校验超时。
get_cert_timeout：获取证书超时。
failed：证书申请失败
